jobs.occupation: Manager / Senior Manager Inhouse Consulting - Healthcare/Life Science (all genders, full-/part-time) (Pharmazeut/in)
jobs.description:
Work Your Magic with us!

Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.

Y our role:

We love consulting! Do you? As the company's internal consultancy, we tackle strategic projects across Healthcare, Life Science, Electronics, and Enabling Functions. Our diverse team of around 75 colleagues brings expertise from top-tier external consultancies, major industry players, and top academic institutions. With offices in Darmstadt (HQ), the Greater Boston Area (USA), and Singapore, we deliver high-impact projects to the company's most critical business challenges. Working directly with senior management, we lead local, regional, and global initiatives that drive organizational success. Beyond providing consulting services, we serve as a talent incubator for our company, with a considerable number of colleagues transitioning into key leadership or expert roles throughout the organization every year. Combining both business consulting and people development, we contribute to the company's success and accelerate your career!

You will work as part of project teams, providing business consulting across our sectors and business functions, before transitioning to the next exciting career step within our company after approximately 2-4 years.

In this role, you will primarily focus on the Healthcare and Life Science sectors, ideally leveraging your scientific background in fields such as medicine, pharmacy, biology or chemistry. Typical projects range from strategy development on sector, franchise or country level to more operational projects in various functions (R&D, Regulatory, Market Access, Operations, etc.). While your impact will be centered on these domains, you will have the flexibility to extend your influence on strategic initiatives beyond this scope as needed. As a colleague and trusted partner, you support projects from design to implementation, inspiring changes throughout the organization. You handle interactions with internal clients, guide project teams in flat team structures, and proactively identify and apply Data & AI opportunities.

Our approach differs from external consulting. We offer:

Empowerment : You own your projects from proposal development to steering committee presentations, and project closure. Project assignments are matched with your individual development goals and reflect your level of seniority. You will be able to directly experience the impact your work has on our business and patients worldwide.

Career development : Your leadership in challenging consulting projects will give you high visibility across our business sectors, allowing you to cultivate a deep internal network and ultimately positioning you for a successful transition into your next chapter within our company. While advancing your own professional growth, you simultaneously invest in mentoring and developing junior colleagues.

Flexibility of work : You will experience our high-impact culture with less business travel and more flexible work arrangements than in external consulting. Moreover, we run a hybrid workplace approach with a healthy mix of remote work and office presence.

Who you are:

- Master's degree in medicine, pharmacy, biology, chemistry, or a related field; PhD or MBA is a plus
- Work experience of 3–5 years in a leading management consulting firm, with a focus on the Healthcare and/or Life Sciences sectors (e.g., pharma, biotech, diagnostics, bioprocessing, biology, chemistry)
- Functional expertise in at least one of the following areas: R&D, Regulatory, Market Access & Pricing, Operations, Marketing & Sales
- Practical experience in applying Data & AI to solve business challenges, and the passion to continue developing skills in this field
- Strong track record of leading projects across multiple functional areas with exposure to different hierarchy levels. More extensive leadership experience is a plus
- Excellent communication and presentation skills, creativity, analytical strength, and strategic thinking
- Proactive, self-motivated work approach and with a passion for working in teams
- Proficiency in English and preferably also in German
- Willingness to relocate to Rhine-Main-Area (e.g., Darmstadt, Frankfurt) to allow for regular office presence (2–3 days per week) for close collaboration and network building

What we offer:We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We celebrate all dimensions of diversity and believe that it drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!

Apply now and become a part of our diverse team!

Our mission is to make roads safer, enable autonomous driving in all-weather scenarios, optimize traffic flow for reduced travel times and to reliably and efficiently detect threats from drones and other aircraft.

We are looking for a deputy leader of our Defense and Automotive department, who will drive the development of our latest defense and automotive products, which are software-defined radar sensors, and contribute to delivering cutting-edge radar systems and solutions to our fast-growing customer base.

You will lead a team of ~15 engineers in the following fields:
• Smartmicro standard products mainstream development team (C-UAS sensors, altimeters and automotive sensors).
• Customer projects teams who make customer-specific C-UAS or altimeter products.
• Application-specific tracking, classification and sensor fusion software

Your Tasks
• You are supporting the department manager and take over certain tasks directly
• You are responsible for coordinating projects and prioritizing tasks between the department and the embedded- and other software departments, with strong customer focus
• You will support the leadership of the teams within your department, fostering a strong culture of teamwork in collaboration with the group leaders and other departments
• This includes coaching, motivating, managing and giving technical guidance to the team members

• Completed Master or PhD. in the field of software engineering, computer science or similar

• Also, a deep understanding of embedded hard- and software
• Strong commitment to achieving project schedules and milestones, with the ability to inspire the same mindset across the teams
• You can show high social and leadership skills, next to a strong motivation and result-driven personality
• You have excellent communication skills, with the ability to take on mentoring roles and organize feedback

What you can expect from us

• Pleasant working environment: informal culture, motivated teams, short communication channels, room for active participation
• Future-oriented workplace: permanent employment and individual training opportunities
• Attractive location: located directly next to the highway and bus stop, with parking facilities for cars and bikes

• Other benefits

About us Become a part of our innovative company and join us to develop the leading technology in the field of radar and hybrid sensors and systems.

jobs.occupation: F&DT Structural Analysis Engineer (d/f/m) (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Airbus bietet moderne und treibstoffeffiziente Verkehrsflugzeuge sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen an. Airbus ist auch führend in Europa im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit und eines der größten Raumfahrtunternehmen der Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.
Job description

In order to support our engineering activities, Airbus Aerostructures is looking for a

F&DT Structural Analysis Engineer (d/f/m)

In this role, you will contribute to the structural integrity and safety of Airbus aircraft. As a key member of our Structural Analysis Community, you will handle calculations and support our digital transformation initiatives, collaborating closely with design, production and subcontracting partners.

This role is also available with reduced weekly hours and an adapted scope of tasks.

Your Location

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your Tasks and Responsibilities

- Create analysis models, static and/or F&DT calculations, reports and studies for Airbus aircraft structures (A350XWB and A320 Family)
- Prepare the definition of analysis methods and specifications
- Check internally and externally created analysis data and documentation
- Check relevant input to design for the creation of drawings for manufacturing and support other functions (i.e.: production, customer support) as needed
- Technically guide the sub-contracting companies providing structure analysis work
- Apply airworthiness regulations and relevant design principles
- Define and interpret structural tests for certification
- Monitor project performance
- Support the digital transformation within the structural analysis department by implementing automation, simplifying tools, and redesigning processes.

Desired Skills and Qualifications

- University degree in the engineering / aerospace field or similar qualification acquired in another way
- Experience in the development of aircraft structures (metal & composite) would be a plus
- Knowledge in numerical calculations
- Proficiency in analytical calculation methods (e.g.ISAMI, HSB, Niu, Bruhn)
- Solid knowledge in programming languages (e.g.: Python) and data analytics
- Motivation to work autonomously, take responsibilities and foster communication with all stakeholders
- Open and curious mindset proactively searching for continuous self-development
- English fluency in written and spoken form

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

jobs.occupation: Regional Head (m,w,d) of Tax, Central and Eastern Europe (Steuerberater/in)
jobs.description:
Who we are

Worldline helps businesses of all shapes and sizes to accelerate their growth journey - quickly, simply, and securely. We are the innovators at the heart of the payments technology industry, shaping how the world pays and gets paid. Our technology powers the growth of millions of businesses across 5 continents. And just as we help our customers accelerate their business, we are committed to helping our people accelerate their careers. Together, we shape the evolution.

The opportunity

At Worldline, our technology addresses persistent challenges of the payment world. We design and operate leading digital payment and transactional solutions that enable sustainable economic growth and reinforce trust and security in our societies. If you are a highly-skilled Tax director, specialized in German and Swiss tax, then get ready to join our company.

This role will report to the Group Head of Tax.

Day-to-day responsibilities

As a Regional Head (m,w,d) of Tax, Central and Eastern Europe, which include main entities notably in Germany, Switzerland, Austria and Poland, you will be in charge of all the tax aspects related to this perimeter that can evolve depending on the activity. You will be the key contact and stakeholder of local accounting, controlling, legal and finances teams, as well as the main interlocutor for local tax authorities. You will also work closely with the group tax team in order to ensure proper implementation of group tax policy and strategy.

Your key responsibilities include:

- Manage tax aspects of subsidiaries mainly in Germany, Austria, Switzerland and Poland (including country-specific tax structuring, transfer pricing compliance, limitation of interest deductibility, and local tax consolidation group) and compliance aspects, as CIT, VAT, local taxes returns and ensure compliance with local regulations.
- Support local finance teams for annual financial statements under IFRS and local accounting rules (German HGB, Austrian UGB, Swiss GAAP); ensure correct and optimal application of IFRS, translating IFRS and tax standards into practical processes used across administrations.
- Take ownership of tax processes at Group level for the Tax Cluster area and ensure coordination between local teams, Group Finance, and external advisors (including transfer pricing documentation, foreign tax credits, local incentives, and subsidies)
- Provide advice and support to group tax team, finance, legal and operational teams on  tax matters including CIT, VAT, and country-specific taxes and compliance requirements. Identify issues and drive effective solutions
- Conduct tax monitoring across the Tax Cluster perimeter, build local tax manuals and guides that are user friendly and understandable to a larger audience; train local finance and tax teams when required
- Ensure management of tax audits and litigations as well as relationships with tax authorities in each jurisdiction: prepare, coordinate and validate responses (with support from external advisors if necessary).
- Anticipate and assess tax risks across the Tax cluster perimeter, considering local regulatory changes and multi-country implications and work closely with group tax team in this respect. Identify issues and drive effective solutions
- Support the group and local finance teams on reporting (budget/actuals/forecast), on the determination of tax results, current and deferred tax charges and VAT recovery ratio across all  Tax Cluster entities, coordinate the tax reporting and tax package process with local stakeholders, automate and improve processes, and harmonize local submissions as appropriate.
- Monitor tax legislation and case law developments and ensure proactive adaptation.

This list is non-exhaustive and is intended to evolve with the position and the person who joins the team.

Who are we looking for

We look for big thinkers. People who can drive positive change, step up and show what’s next – people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow.

- Minimum 12 years of experience within international direct taxation at Big4, international law firm or at a multinational organization; pursued graduation from university (Tax Law or Tax Economics).
- Professional proficiency of English and German is required
- Expert in Excel and good knowledge of reporting tool (SAP)
- You demonstrate expertise in international Group tax matters, leveraging your previous experience.
- You are diligent, independent, proactive, with strong analytical and synthesis abilities, and excellent written communication skills. 
- You take initiative, bring forward strategic proposals, and have strong interpersonal capabilities.
- Knowledge of the payments, eCommerce or FinTech industry is a plus.

Perks & Benefits

At Worldline you’ll get the chance to be at the heart of the global payments technology industry and shape how the world pays and gets paid. On top of that, you will also:

- Be part of a company guided by a strong purpose to do good and recognized as top 1% of the most sustainable companies in all sectors worldwide
- Work with inspiring colleagues and be empowered to learn, grow and accelerate your career
- An exciting salary
- At Worldline our top priority is to engage, encourage and develop you to help you improve your potential. In fact, we have comprehensive training and development programs in place demonstrating our dedication to developing your career
- And many more...

#LI-AB1

Shape the evolution

We are on an exciting journey towards the next frontiers of payments technology, and we look for big thinkers, people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. Here you'll work with ambitious colleagues from around the world, take on unique challenges as a team, and make a real impact on the society. With an empowering culture, strong technology and extensive training opportunities, we help you accelerate your career - wherever you decide to go. Join our global team of 18,000 innovators and shape a tomorrow that is yours to own. 

Learn more about life at Worldline at jobs.worldline.com

jobs.description:
Senior Program Manager

This is Worldline

We are the innovators at the heart of the payments technology industry, shaping how the world pays and gets paid. The solutions our people build today power the growth of millions of businesses tomorrow. From your local coffee shop to unicorns and international banks. From San Francisco to Auckland. We are in every corner of the world, in every part of commerce. And just as we help our customers accelerate their business, we are committed to helping our people accelerate their careers. Together, we shape the evolution.

Benefits

- Hybrid working
- Home office and meal allowance
- Extensive continuing education programs
- Wide range of employee discounts
- Regular employee events
- Employee Share Program: We win together as a team, and our long-term incentive plans are crafted to give every Worldline a financial stake in the business they are helping to grow
- Sustainable, international corporate culture

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

Core Program and Project Management skills

- Management of multiple client programs and projects involving implementations of complex IT solutions in the area of digital payments and financial services
- Pre-sales consultation and project business case development/management to ensure appropriate project initiation and customer engagement
- Effective project planning in line with business priorities as well as associated cost and timeline boundaries. Identification of, and effective engagement with, appropriate stakeholders. Identification and procurement of all project resources and effective scheduling of shared human resources within a matrix managed organization
- Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation and client-facing skills

- Work closely with customer, senior project managers, senior responsible owners/stakeholders and key team members to ensure that the program / project goals are realistic, the correct delivery structure/environment is created to support the scope of work and clear lines of accountability are established
- Establish and maintain high standards of project accounting and financial reporting, setting and respecting suitable budgets/margins for delivery
- Ensuring revenue and cost recognition is in line with corporate policy
- Control of changes to program / project in line with commercial controls and strategic priority
- Effective evaluation, planning and management of contingency. Identification and management of risks/issues/actions to ensure satisfactory completion and delivery to project milestone plans, deploying effective escalation where required.
- Creation and ongoing management of professional program & project artefacts, ensuring delivery to a high standard.
- Create, execute and update the roadmap and project plans based on the input from all contributors. Continuously evaluating progress and enriching information to communicate program / project goals and status effectively and professionally to multiple audiences, at all levels, within Worldline and customer organizations.
- Effective management of program/project closure and/or delivery continuity with all internal and external stakeholders. Benefits review and validation of desired outcomes in line with scope of work completed.

Other related skills

- Proactive identification and presentation of business change opportunities to the senior management team
- Proactive research of current industry standards and best practice for project management, making proposals for delivering improvements.

Who Are We Looking For

We look for big thinkers. People who can drive positive change, step up and show what's next - people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. We need the following knowledge:

- Minimum 5 years' experience in a customer facing Program / Project Management role
- Experience of managing large-scale software implementation projects essential
- Demonstrable experience of delivering projects in a technology environment
- Excellent leadership skills, with the ability to influence and engage the stakeholders at all levels
- Self-supportive with a high degree of initiative and enthusiasm, requiring minimal management
- Ability to analyze and present business case requirements, Program & Project goals and progress at a senior management
- Proven ability to manage and deliver in a multi-project, matrix managed environment
- Fluent in English, proficiency in additional languages is a plus
- Agile approach experience is highly appreciated
- Financial Services, Issuing processes experience preferred
- PMP or Prince2 Practitioner level (or equivalent) preferred
- Flexibility to travel

Shape the evolution

We are on an exciting journey towards the next frontiers of payments technology, and we look for big thinkers, people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. Here you'll work with ambitious colleagues from around the world, take on unique challenges as a team, and make a real impact on the society. With an empowering culture, strong technology and

extensive training opportunities, we help you accelerate your career - wherever you decide to go. Join our global team of 18,000 innovators and shape a tomorrow that is yours to own.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as an individual with a disability, or any applicable legally protected characteristics.

jobs.occupation: ERP Integration Lead (all genders) (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description:
Work Your Magic with us!

Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.

Your Role:

As the ERP Integration Lead for the our Life Science business, you will lead the governance, design, and continuous evolution of the application integration landscape supporting our global SAP S/4HANA transformation program. Working closely with Business Process and IT Solution Owners, the ERP Design and Build organization, the Deployment Leads, Integrated Enterprise Solutions as well as our implementation partners, you will drive the delivery of scalable, standardized, secure, and compliant integrations between SAP S/4HANA and connected business applications. You will provide technical leadership throughout the integration lifecycle from architecture and solution design through implementation, deployment readiness, and cutover support. Your leadership will ensure a robust and resilient integration landscape that enables successful global deployments while preserving enterprise architecture principles and clean core standards.

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the end-to-end ERP Integration function within the global SAP S/4HANA transformation program.
- Own the governance, quality, and continuous evolution of the application integration landscape supporting the global ERP template.
- Define and govern enterprise integration principles, interface standards, API strategies, middleware architecture, and integration patterns across SAP and connected business applications.
- Govern technical integration decisions and ensure alignment with enterprise architecture principles, clean core strategy, and global technology standards.
- Provide leadership and governance for the design, implementation, testing, and deployment of application integrations across functional workstreams and implementation partners.
- Ensure integration consistency and technical solution integrity across multiple concurrent deployment programs while balancing global standardization with justified local requirements.
- Partner closely with Deployment Leads to enable technical deployment readiness, interface validation, cutover planning, technical issue resolution, and successful deployment execution.
- Collaborate with ERP Design and Build, Data Migration, Testing, Validation, Security, Enterprise Architecture, Digital Manufacturing, and other technology teams to deliver an integrated enterprise solution.
- Ensure application integrations are designed, built, tested, and delivered in compliance with validation requirements, and global quality standards by partnering closely with Validation organizations to support deployments into regulated environments.
- Drive planning and governance for integration readiness, interface testing, technical defect resolution, deployment preparation, and cutover activities across all integrated applications.
- Identify technical risks, interface dependencies, and architectural constraints early and proactively manage mitigation plans to support successful program delivery.
- Provide leadership and direction to internal teams, external implementation partners, SAP, and technology vendors while driving accountability, delivery excellence, and effective collaboration.
- Leverage SAP Integration Suite, SAP Business Technology Platform, APIs, event driven architecture, and emerging SAP technologies to continuously improve the enterprise integration landscape and accelerate future deployments.

Who You Are:

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
- 10 or more years of experience leading SAP integration, enterprise application integration, or large scale SAP S/4HANA transformation programs.
- Extensive experience designing and governing enterprise application integration landscapes supporting SAP and non SAP business applications.
- Strong understanding of SAP S/4HANA technical architecture, SAP Integration Suite, SAP Business Technology Platform, APIs, middleware technologies, and modern enterprise integration patterns.
- Proven leadership experience managing global technical teams and implementation partners across multiple concurrent initiatives.
- Strong knowledge of enterprise integration governance, enterprise architecture, clean core principles, cybersecurity, and SAP implementation methodologies.
- Demonstrated experience leading integration solution delivery in GxP regulated Life Science, Pharmaceutical, Medical Device, or similarly regulated industries is highly desirable.
- Deep understanding of deployment readiness, integration testing, interface validation, technical cutover planning, and transition from build to deployment.
- Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence senior business and IT leaders across global organizations.
- Outstanding communication and presentation skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business value.
- Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills with the ability to balance technology strategy, business value, operational stability, risk, and delivery timelines.
- Demonstrated ability to lead cross functional teams without direct authority in a matrix organization.
- Experience leading multiple concurrent initiatives within a global ERP transformation program.
- Fluent in English. German or another European language is considered an advantage.

This role does not offer sponsorship for work authorization. External applicants must be eligible to work in Germany.

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.

In order to support ARP Program, Airbus is looking for a

Product Owner in the ERP (ARP) /SAP Transformation (d/f/m)

The ARP Program is the cornerstone of Airbus's digital transformation, aiming to harmonize and optimize our industrial processes across all global sites. We believe this initiative will set new industry standards and significantly enhance our operational efficiency and enable the ramp-up. We're not just implementing SAP; we're reimagining how aerospace manufacturing operates and we drive our E2E flows.

Your location

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.
